instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize NativeWind: Ensure tailwind.config.js is set up for creating styled components.
2. Setup Navigation: Use expo-router with a Tabs layout (Map, Search, Create, Bookings, Profile).
3. Map Integration: Since MapLibre requires native code, if you are in Expo Go, Mock the map component with a static image and interactive pins for MVP.
4. Component Strategy: Use react-native-reusables patterns. Do not import 'shadcn-ui' directly as it is for web.
5. Dark Mode: Respect the system preference but default to Light mode for the 'Fresh/Local' feel.
6. Create 'TagPoint' context: A global state to manage the selected tag on the map.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped mobile designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (Pressable scale feedback).
Do NOT center align the app container. Use Flexbox logically.
Always use safe-area-context to handle notches and dynamic islands.
Use 'sonner' (native equivalent) or a custom toast for notifications.
All interactive elements MUST include testID attribute.
